title: When This Passing World Is Done
firstLine: When this passing world is done, when has sunk yon glaring sun, when I stand with Christ on high, looking o'er life's history -- then Lord, shall I fully know, not till then, how much I owe. Then Lord, shall I fully know, not till then how much I owe.

lines: When this passing world is done, when has sunk yon glaring sun, when I stand with Christ on high, looking o'er life's history -- then Lord, shall I fully know, not till then, how much I owe. Then Lord, shall I fully know, not till then how much I owe.

When I stand before the throne, dressed in beauty not my own, when I see Thee as Thou art, love Thee with unsinning heart - then, Lord, shall I fully know, not till then, how much I owe. Then Lord, shall I fully know, not till then, how much I owe.

When the praise of heav'n I hear, loud as thunder to the ear, loud as many waters' noise, sweet as harp's melodious voice -- then Lord, shall I fully know, not till then, how much I owe. Then, Lord, shall I fully know, not till then, how much I owe.
